description: Uranium Production is a dataset listed in KAPSARC Data Portal, an energy economics open data portal, published or maintained by King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC). This dataset contains Uranium Production 2007-2021. Data from World Nuclear Association. Follow datasource.kapsarc.org for timely data to advance energy economics research. Data from the World Nuclear Association. NB: the figures in this table are liable to change as new data becomes available. Coverage: as titled: Saudi Arabia, the Gulf states, India or the world (see the dataset page). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Renewable & Other Fuels. Its keywords are Reserves, Nuclear, Uranium, Production. The portal shows 2025-01-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy, water and transport system studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kapsarc-open-data-portal.
